subject: Novum Health - temporary standdown of LLM pilot / revisit in Q4
messages:
From: Kate Miller <kate.miller@novumhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Novum Health Engineering <eng@novumhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:14:00 -0400
Subject: Reprioritizing LLM pilot; temporary hold?

Aditya —

Thanks again for the demo prep and the materials you shared last week. I wanted to give you a heads up: leadership just closed the plan for our Q3 engineering sprint and the LLM/proof-of-concept work is being deprioritized until after the product launch. That means our team is being pulled onto the launch effort and we won't have bandwidth to run the pilot in the next 8–10 weeks.

Can we put the demo and any scheduled hands-on sessions on hold for now? We still believe there's value here, but timing is the constraint. Two asks:
- Please keep our MAP and notes handy and share any short async demo we can point stakeholders to.
- Would you be open to a check-in the first week of September to decide next steps?

Appreciate your flexibility — this is purely a resource / timing change on our side, not a product concern.

Best,
Kate Miller
Director, Product Strategy
Novum Health

(Attached: internal roadmap excerpt referenced in call)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Kate Miller <kate.miller@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Reprioritizing LLM pilot; temporary hold?

Kate —

Thanks for the update and for being candid about timing. Totally understand the launch pull — congrats on the milestone.

A few quick options so we don't lose momentum and so your team has something useful while heads are down:

1) Standby + calendar reminder: we mark the deal as "standby" in HubSpot and set a reminder for Sept 1 to re-engage.
2) Async demo + one-pager: I can send a 12-min recorded walkthrough of the flows we showed and a one-page MAP that calls out required engineering work and expected timeline.
3) Minimal checkpoint: a 15-minute sync in early Sept to validate the roadmap fit.

I've attached an updated mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf that reflects the integration checklist and estimated effort; feel free to keep it internally. If it's helpful we can also drop a short MP4 walkthrough you can share with stakeholders while teams are busy.

Which of the above would be most useful for your team? If you prefer, I'll just put the deal on standby and follow up on Sept 1.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

Team —

Quick notes from Kate's update: leadership has reallocated engineering to a product launch; they asked to pause the pilot and revisit in early Sept. Actions I'm setting up:

- Update HubSpot: set deal stage to "Standby" and add note referencing Kate's roadmap excerpt. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/123456789
- Send async assets: record a 10–12 min walkthrough focused on integration touchpoints + upload to Drive (short URL to attach to deal).
- MAP: finalize mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf and attach to the HubSpot record (done).
- Set reminder: create a task for Sept 1 to re-open cadence and ask for availability in Sept week 1.
- Forecast: move the amount to 'upside' for Q3 and adjust expected close to Q4.

Monica — can you own the HubSpot stage + task? Tessa — can you coordinate the short recording and drop the stub into the deal folder? I'll keep an eye on outreach and follow up on Sept 1.
